name: Red Lentil & Spinach Dahl
method: Soften the chopped onion in the oil with the garlic and curry powder for 3 minutes.
Add the lentils, passata, coconut milk and 300 ml water and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils are soft.
Stir through the spinach until wilted and serve with a spoonful of Greek yogurt.
